Pilot corrected: the tip is the run-2 branch (pilot's own briefing error); spec-altitude added after the fork not deleted; interfaces rewrite never reached the tip; two remote-lag figures; no local branch named origin. lessons: address the lead as team-lead; give a scratchpad path for long reports
teammate subagents hand back to the lead only; either the teammate reads directly or the lead relays

keep the whole team alive to the end; the second pass was where the value was
